taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: The authorised task was text rewriting with image generation explicitly excluded, yet the interface entered a materially different image-generation action state without fresh authority.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The unwanted image-generation state and reported reloads materially engage mechanisms for overriding or repairing unwanted AI behaviour. The partial screenshot and user report do not establish whether an effective stop/override was available, whether invocation completed, or whether reload restored a safe state. Those decisive facts remain unresolved; no failure is inherited from the taxonomy role.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The reported continued unwanted image-generation state despite corrective user input directly raises the OECD unwanted-behaviour override/repair proposition.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: Runtime admission policy is materially relevant to a tool operation activating after the user expressly withheld image-generation permission.
